title: Eco Warriors vs Pollution Empire
description: Lead a team of environmental heroes against the forces of pollution in a tactical grid battle. Plant trees, deploy clean energy, and outmaneuver industrial polluters to save the planet before time runs out.
learning_objectives: Understand environmental challenges and strategic responses
Learn resource management with long-term consequences
Practice balancing urgent action vs sustainable planning
Develop adaptive strategies against growing threats

core_skills.name: Strategic Thinking
core_skills.description: Multi-step planning and positional awareness (executive function)

core_skills.name: Risk Assessment
core_skills.description: Evaluating risk vs reward in environmental decisions (prospect theory)

core_skills.name: Sustainability Patience
core_skills.description: Investing in long-term solutions over quick fixes (self-regulation)

core_skills.name: Adaptability
core_skills.description: Adjusting strategy to evolving environmental threats (cognitive flexibility)

core_skills.name: Resilience
core_skills.description: Continuing effective action after environmental setbacks (psychological resilience)

how_to_play: Select your green eco-warrior pieces to see where they can move
Green dots show safe moves, red highlights show polluters you can neutralize
Use special abilities like Tree Planting and Clean Energy Deployment
Capture the Pollution CEO or reach 50 Green Points to win!
Watch out for toxic zones — they drain your resources
Natural events like storms can change the battlefield!

player_pieces.label: Eco Leader
player_pieces.description: The visionary environmentalist. If captured, the movement fails. Inspires all nearby allies.

player_pieces.label: Tree Planter
player_pieces.description: Fast-moving activist who spreads green cover quickly across the land.

player_pieces.label: Scientist
player_pieces.description: Moves diagonally and can freeze polluters with research breakthroughs.

player_pieces.label: Volunteer
player_pieces.description: Dedicated ground worker. Steady movement in all directions.

ai_pieces.label: Pollution CEO
ai_pieces.description: The head of the pollution empire. Capturing them saves the planet.

ai_pieces.label: Oil Baron
ai_pieces.description: Fast-moving industrialist who spreads pollution rapidly.

ai_pieces.label: Corporate Lobbyist
ai_pieces.description: Powerful diagonal mover that threatens from distance with legal pressure.

ai_pieces.label: Factory Foreman
ai_pieces.description: Reliable industrial enforcer with steady movement.

external_events.label: Climate Storm
external_events.narrative: A massive storm hits the region! All units struggle to move through the devastation.

external_events.label: Green Grant
external_events.narrative: An international organization awards emergency funding to the eco warriors!

external_events.label: EPA Crackdown
external_events.narrative: New environmental regulations slow down all industrial activity!

move_tips.capture: Neutralizing polluters directly reduces environmental damage. In sustainability, removing sources of harm is as important as building clean alternatives.
move_tips.resource: Securing clean energy zones generates ongoing environmental value. In sustainability, renewable resources compound their benefits over time.
move_tips.objective: Holding key ecological zones protects biodiversity. In sustainability, preserving critical habitats prevents irreversible damage.
move_tips.risk: Moving through toxic zones costs resources but may save the ecosystem. In sustainability, short-term sacrifice for long-term health is often necessary.
move_tips.reward: Every cleaned area creates a ripple effect of improvement. In sustainability, positive environmental actions cascade through ecosystems.
move_tips.center: Controlling central areas gives you reach across the entire ecosystem. In sustainability, systemic approaches are more effective than isolated fixes.

transfer_exercises.game_context: Managing resources across multiple rounds to reach the best outcome
transfer_exercises.real_world: Planning study time over a semester rather than cramming before exams
transfer_exercises.challenge: Create a resource management plan for your next month: budget time/money/energy across competing priorities.

transfer_exercises.game_context: Recovering from negative events across game rounds
transfer_exercises.real_world: Maintaining performance after setbacks in a sports season or project
transfer_exercises.challenge: Track your energy/mood for 5 days. Notice patterns. What depletes you? What restores you?

glossary_terms.definition: The process of selecting among alternatives based on available information and values.
glossary_terms.example: Choosing between two career paths based on income, passion, and long-term growth.
glossary_terms.deep_dive: Good decision-making combines rational analysis with awareness of cognitive biases that distort judgment.
glossary_terms.real_world_example: Leaders make high-stakes decisions daily — the quality of their process matters as much as the decision itself.

glossary_terms.definition: Analyzing information objectively to form a well-reasoned judgment.
glossary_terms.example: Questioning whether a statistic is representative before using it to make a decision.
glossary_terms.deep_dive: Critical thinking involves identifying assumptions, evaluating evidence, and considering alternative perspectives.
glossary_terms.real_world_example: Journalists fact-check before publishing; scientists replicate experiments before claiming discoveries.

glossary_terms.definition: The belief that abilities can be developed through effort and learning from failure.
glossary_terms.example: Seeing a poor game result as feedback on what to practice, not evidence of being bad at the game.
glossary_terms.deep_dive: Research by Carol Dweck shows people with growth mindsets achieve more and recover better from setbacks.
glossary_terms.real_world_example: Students who believe intelligence is fixed give up when challenged; those with growth mindset persist and improve.

coaching_moment: Understand environmental challenges and strategic responses. Learn resource management with long-term consequences.
cultural_context: Understanding history builds the contextual thinking valued in India's competitive examinations (UPSC, CBSE, ICSE). Eco Warriors vs Pollution Empire develops the analytical reading of historical events that sharpens both academic performance and civic awareness.
reflection_prompt: Which move opened the board for you, and which closed your options? Why?
